# ActiveCollab

> > ActiveCollab is a comprehensive project management and billing platform purpose-built for scaling service businesses, agencies, and consultancies.

ActiveCollab combines project management, time tracking, resource planning, and financial management into a unified platform designed for professional service firms. The platform integrates with popular tools like Slack, Google Drive, Dropbox, and payment processors (Stripe, PayPal, QuickBooks) to streamline workflows and improve profitability.

## Key Topics

- Project Management
- Time Tracking
- Team Collaboration
- Resource Planning
- Invoicing & Billing
- Capacity Planning
- Task Management
- Workload Management
- Productivity Tracking
- Client Management
- Profitability Analysis
- Service Businesses
- Agency Tools
- Payment Processing
- Integrations

## Core Features

- [Features Made For Growth – Collaboration, Productivity & Billing](https://activecollab.com/features): Overview of ActiveCollab's core features for scaling service businesses.
- [Project Management For Growing Agencies & Consultancies](https://activecollab.com/features/project-management): Project management capabilities including task tracking, Gantt charts, and kanban boards.
- [Time Tracking Software For Agencies & Consultancies](https://activecollab.com/features/time-tracking-software): Time tracking across tasks, projects, and clients with invoicing integration.
- [Productivity & Resource Planning for Agencies – ActiveCollab](https://activecollab.com/features/productivity-and-resource-planning): Resource planning and workload management tools for optimizing team capacity.
- [Explore ActiveCollab's Team Collaboration Feature](https://activecollab.com/features/team-collaboration-and-communication): In-app chat, file sharing, and team communication as email alternative.
- [Client Management For Professional Service Businesses](https://activecollab.com/features/client-management): Client relationship management with feedback, discussions, and progress reporting.

## Financial Management

- [Profitability & Budgeting Software For Service Businesses](https://activecollab.com/features/budgeting-and-profitability): Budget tracking, cost management, and profitability analysis for service firms.
- [Expense Tracking & Invoicing Software For Service Businesses](https://activecollab.com/features/invoicing-and-expense-tracking): Automated invoicing, expense tracking, and payment processing integration.
- [Profitability & Productivity Reporting For Service Businesses](https://activecollab.com/features/reporting-and-dashboards): Custom reporting dashboards for productivity, profitability, and project insights.
